# YieldNest.online

> Independent Mutual Fund Research & Analytics Platform for Indian Equity & Debt Schemes.

YieldNest.online provides independent, quantitative, data-driven research on Indian Mutual Funds. Our articles analyze 3-year and 5-year rolling returns, downside capture ratios, standard deviation, portfolio overlap, expense ratio (TER) compounding drag, and AMFI India liquidity stress test disclosures.

We are strictly an investor education and quantitative research publication. Not registered with SEBI or AMFI; no financial advisory services, distributor commissions, or solicitation.

## Core Research Articles

- [Mutual Funds vs FD vs SIP: The 2026 Strategic Wealth Guide](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/mutual-funds-vs-fd-vs-sip-2026-analysis): Confused between FDs and Mutual Funds? Our 2026 analysis compares risk, returns, and tax efficiency to help you optimize your portfolio for long-term wealth.
- [Mutual Funds vs Real Estate: The 2026 Wealth Creation Verdict](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/mutual-funds-vs-real-estate-investing-2026): Should you invest in property or equity funds in 2026? We analyze liquidity, taxation, and 5-year CAGR data to help you decide your optimal asset allocation.
- [Decoding Mutual Fund NAV: How It Is Calculated and Why It Matters](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/decoding-mutual-fund-nav-calculation-and-importance): Confused by NAV? Discover how NAV is calculated, why it differs from stock prices, and what it means for your 2026 investment strategy at YieldNest.online.
- [Mid-Cap vs. Multi-Cap: Navigating the 2026 Valuation Premium](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/mid-cap-vs-multi-cap-navigating-2026-valuation-premium): As Indian equities hit record valuations in September 2026, we analyze whether Mid-Cap or Multi-Cap strategies offer better risk-adjusted returns for investors.
- [Mid-Cap vs. Small-Cap: Analyzing Risk-Adjusted Returns Amidst Current Market Volatility](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/mid-cap-vs-small-cap-analyzing-risk-adjusted-returns-amidst-current-market): With mid and small-cap indices testing new highs, we analyze the Sharpe and Sortino ratios of top-performing schemes to determine if the current valuation premium is justified by fundamental growth.
- [Mutual Funds vs ETFs: The Definitive Indian Investor Guide](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/mutual-funds-vs-etfs-india-guide): Should you choose Mutual Funds or ETFs? We analyze TER, liquidity, and alpha generation using AMFI data to help you optimize your portfolio strategy.
- [Can Mutual Funds Change Expense Ratio? A Deep Dive for Investors](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/can-mutual-funds-change-expense-ratio): Does your mutual fund's expense ratio fluctuate? Discover how SEBI regulations govern TER changes and how they impact your long-term compounding returns.
- [Can Mutual Funds Invest in IPOs? A Quantitative Perspective](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/can-mutual-funds-invest-in-ipo): Explore how mutual funds participate in IPOs, the regulatory framework governing these investments, and what it means for your portfolio's alpha generation.
- [Transferring Mutual Funds to Your Son: Legal and Tax Implications](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/transfer-mutual-funds-to-son-legal-tax-guide): Can you gift mutual funds to your son? Discover the legal, tax, and procedural requirements for transferring units in India as per AMFI and SEBI guidelines.
- [Are Mutual Funds Tax-Free? A Quantitative Guide to Indian Taxation](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/are-mutual-funds-tax-free-india-guide): Demystifying mutual fund taxation in India. Learn how LTCG, STCG, and dividend distribution impact your net returns and portfolio compounding.
- [Are Mutual Funds Safe? A Data-Driven Reality Check for Investors](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/are-mutual-funds-safe-investment-analysis): Are mutual funds safe? We dissect market volatility, AMFI riskometers, and historical CAGR to separate investment risk from capital loss.
- [How Mutual Funds Make Money: Decoding the Asset Management Business](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/how-mutual-funds-make-money-business-model): Ever wondered how AMCs profit from your investments? We break down the Total Expense Ratio (TER), management fees, and the economics of fund management.
- [Decoding Mutual Fund Taxation in India: A 2026 Comprehensive Guide](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/mutual-fund-taxation-india-guide): Master the complexities of Indian mutual fund taxation. Learn how Equity, Debt, and Hybrid funds are taxed post-2024 updates to optimize your post-tax returns.
- [How to Compare Mutual Funds in India: A Data-Driven Framework (2026)](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/best-mutual-funds-india-2026-data-analysis): Discover the top-performing mutual funds for 2026. Our data-driven analysis covers CAGR, alpha, and risk metrics to help you build a robust investment portfolio.
- [Quant Small Cap vs Nippon India Small Cap: A Data-Driven Analysis](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/quant-small-cap-vs-nippon-india-small-cap-comparison): Analyzing Quant Small Cap and Nippon India Small Cap: Which fund deserves a spot in your portfolio? We break down performance, risk, and strategy.
- [The Hidden Tax: Why Total Expense Ratio (TER) Dictates Your Wealth](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/why-total-expense-ratio-ter-is-important-for-investors): Discover how the Total Expense Ratio (TER) silently erodes your long-term mutual fund returns. Learn why even a 1% difference matters for your financial goals.
- [AMFI & Regulatory Guidelines: Categorization Norms, Liquidity Mandates & Riskometer Framework](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/amfi-latest-regulatory-updates-categorization-norms-transparency): An exhaustive review of mutual fund regulatory guidelines, scheme categorization boundaries, bi-monthly liquidity stress tests, and dynamic riskometers.
- [Direct vs Regular Mutual Funds: The Compounding Drag of Distributor Commissions & Total Expense Ratios](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/direct-vs-regular-mutual-funds-charges-commissions-compounding): A mathematical analysis of Total Expense Ratio (TER) differentials, distributor trail commissions, and the 20-year wealth impact of direct investing.
- [How to Measure Mutual Fund Performance: Rolling Returns, Alpha, Beta & Risk-Adjusted Ratios](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/evaluating-mutual-fund-performance-rolling-returns-risk-ratios): Why point-to-point trailing returns mislead investors. A master framework utilizing 3Y and 5Y rolling returns, Sharpe, Sortino, and downside capture.
- [Parag Parikh Flexi Cap vs Mirae Asset Large & Midcap: 5-Year Rolling Return Analysis](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/parag-parikh-flexi-cap-vs-mirae-asset-large-midcap): A comprehensive analysis of downside protection, international equity allocations, and expense ratio drag across bull and bear market cycles.
- [Small Cap Mutual Funds Stress Test: Liquidity Risk, Days-to-Liquidate & Market Resilience](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/small-cap-mutual-funds-stress-test-sebi-amfi-liquidity): An empirical examination of liquidity stress test disclosures across top small-cap funds, analyzing redemption shock absorption.
- [NIFTY 50 Index Funds vs Active Large-Cap Funds: Is Alpha Dead in Indian Equities?](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/nifty-50-index-funds-vs-active-large-cap-funds): SPIVA scorecards reveal over 85% of active large-cap managers fail to beat their benchmark. A quantitative comparison of expense ratios and compounding.

## Quantitative Calculators Suite

- [Mutual Fund Calculators Hub](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators): Central directory of financial math simulators for Indian mutual fund investors.
- [SIP Compounding Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/sip): Simulate systematic compounding, post-tax returns, and multi-year wealth accumulation.
- [SWP Longevity Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/swp): Simulate systematic withdrawal plans, monthly cash flows, principal preservation, and portfolio longevity.
- [Goal Planner Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/goal-planner): Back-calculate the required monthly SIP to achieve inflation-adjusted life goals (education, house, retirement).
- [Mutual Fund Tax Estimator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/tax-estimator): Calculate capital gains tax, holding periods, Section 112A exemption, and net proceeds under Finance Act 2024.
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/lumpsum): Calculate compounded growth and wealth multipliers on one-time mutual fund deposits.
- [Direct vs Regular TER Drag Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/direct-vs-regular): Quantify wealth erosion caused by distributor trail commissions (0.5%–1.5% TER headwind).
- [Step-Up SIP Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/step-up-sip): Model annual SIP contribution increments (5%–25%) alongside salary growth.
- [Cost of Delay Calculator](https://www.yieldnest.online/calculators/cost-of-delay): Calculate the financial penalty of procrastinating SIP start dates by 6 to 24 months.
